verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents Spot Node Pools in CKS as pay-as-you-go bare-metal compute with no commitments, plus Capacity Finder for checking zone availability first. The pricing page markets burst Spot capacity with "great pricing." So the spot product itself is first-party documented, but the evidence never quantifies the discount or explains interruption behavior. missing for 10: documented discount depth versus on-demand, preemption/interruption semantics (notice period, eviction behavior, reclaim conditions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
